mapper.select: SELECT ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, MEMBERSHIP_GRADE, TOTAL_VISIT_COUNT, MEMO FROM CUSTOMER WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CUSTOMER (ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD, NAME, PHONE, EMAIL) VALUES (CUSTOMER_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email})
mapper.update: UPDATE CUSTOMER SET TOTAL_VISIT_COUNT = TOTAL_VISIT_COUNT + 1, MEMBERSHIP_GRADE = CASE WHEN TOTAL_VISIT_COUNT + 1 >= 10 THEN 'VIP' ELSE MEMBERSHIP_GRADE END WHERE ID = (SELECT GUEST_ID FROM CHECKIN_STATUS WHERE ID = #{checkinId})
